description: An expander for RackNES that writes values straight into the running game's memory, eight memory locations at a time, in the manner of a Game Genie

inputs.text: Writes to the game memory location chosen in the selector on its row: 0V gives that location's lowest value, 10V its highest. Where it has only two values, a rising edge past 2V flips it.

notes: this module goes immediately to the right of RackNES and does nothing anywhere else.
click the top display to choose the game, and a row's display to choose which memory location that row writes to. Being displays rather than knobs, they carry no help of their own.
only two games are mapped, Super Mario Bros. with 53 memory locations and The Legend of Zelda with 55; the module has nothing to write for any other ROM.
choose a game and a memory location before patching a cable in. With no game chosen, the module reads its tables at index -1, which is outside them.
